answer: Histories are stored in horizon, checked in nadir, and relic shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 5 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1517 identities would post 2327 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
